_note: Aurora writer acme-prod-aurora-writer (us-east-1, db.r6g.4xlarge, 128 GB RAM). Queries 20 (CPUUtilization, FreeableMemory, DatabaseConnections, --period 3600) and 21 (list-metrics existence check). A raw-CPU instinct sees 12% average CPU and flags a downsize. The BINDING CONSTRAINT for a database is memory/connections, not CPU: FreeableMemory sits near 1.7 GB of 128 GB and DatabaseConnections rises toward the parameter-group max, so the instance is memory- and connection-bound and NOT downsizeable. Compute Optimizer (query 7) reports Optimized. Excluded from the remediation table; reported under Informational / excluded.

FreeableMemory.Label: FreeableMemory
FreeableMemory._note: min ~1.6 GB, avg ~1.9 GB free of 128 GB total — the instance is memory-bound.

DatabaseConnections.Label: DatabaseConnections
